title: Counting a Personal Services Plan's Time in Force for Suspension Purposes
content:
For a Personal Services Plan package suspended for as long as the package allows, the whole months of the plan's time in force depend on where the resident came from and on the plan's suspension record. The rule reads the assisted living residency the plan serves (under the Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement), the resident's earlier Independent Living Residency Agreement, and the plan's own record.

## Rule

The whole months of time in force that decide the time-in-force months are counted by one of three methods: where the resident came to the assisted living residency the plan serves from a Larkspur independent living residency whose move-in date is on record, they run from that earlier move-in date, so that years as a Larkspur resident carry over; where the resident did not and the plan has a recorded suspension, they run from the plan's effective date and the months of that suspension are taken away, so that months on hold do not count; otherwise they run from the plan's effective date.

Whole months are counted from the earlier date to the date of the request, a whole month elapsing on the same day of each later month. The months of a recorded suspension are the calendar months it covers, from its first suspended month to its last.

## Method by record

| Admission source on the assisted living residency | Independent living move-in date on record | Plan's recorded suspension | Whole months of time in force |
|---|---|---|---|
| A Larkspur independent living residency | Yes | Any | Whole months since the independent living move-in date |
| Not a Larkspur independent living residency, or no assisted living residency | — | Yes | Whole months since the plan's effective date, less the months of that suspension |
| Not a Larkspur independent living residency, or no assisted living residency | — | None | Whole months since the plan's effective date |

## Worked examples (hypothetical request dated 15 September 2026)

- An assisted living resident admitted from a Larkspur independent living residency whose move-in date was 15 March 2022, with a plan effective 1 June 2025: 54 whole months since 15 March 2022.
- An independent living resident whose plan took effect on 1 March 2024 and was suspended for March and April 2025: 30 whole months since 1 March 2024, less 2 months of suspension, gives 28 months.
- The same plan with no suspension on record: 30 months.
